title: NSE Scam: PC Act case against Chitra Ramkrishna to proceed after Delhi HC rejects challenge to definitions of public duty, public servant
description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday rejected the plea filed by Chitra Ramkrishna, the former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the National Stock Exchange (NSE), challenging the definitions of ‘public duty’ and ‘public servant’ under the Prevention of Corruption Act (PC Act). A Division Bench of Justices Navin Chawla and Ravinder Dudeja ruled that the NSE performs a public duty and Ramkrishna, being its Managing Director (MD) and CEO, cannot be wholly separated from the functions performed by the NS
